title: 国防AI中'人在回路'必不可少
titleEn: Man in the loop a must when using AI in defence
summary: 新加坡国防部长陈春生强调，在军事AI应用中人类必须保持决策控制权。
summaryEn: Singapore's Defence Minister Chan Chun Sing argues that humans must remain in control of decision-making when AI is used in military operations.
speaker: Chan Chun Sing
